chatbotQuestion: How do I request access to an application?
chatbotAnswer: Open the User Management app, select Applications, and submit an access request. Your line manager receives an approval task.

chatbotQuestion: What is the Delegation of Authority (DoA) process?
chatbotAnswer: DoA defines who can approve requests and up to which value. Approvals are routed to the authorized approver based on the request type and amount.

chatbotQuestion: How long does an approval request stay open?
chatbotAnswer: Requests remain open until the approver acts on them. Escalation is triggered automatically after the configured reminder period.

chatbotQuestion: Who can I contact if my access request is rejected?
chatbotAnswer: Contact the approver listed on the rejection notice. If you need further help, raise a ticket with the application support team.

chatbotQuestion: Can I withdraw a request after submitting it?
chatbotAnswer: Yes. Open My Requests, select the pending request, and choose Withdraw. Withdrawn requests cannot be reopened and must be resubmitted.
An exception approval is used when a request falls outside standard DoA limits. It requires review by a higher-level approver before it can be processed.

chatbotQuestion: How do I onboard an external user?
chatbotAnswer: Use the External Onboarding screen, enter the user's company email and required applications, then submit. The external user receives an invitation link.

chatbotQuestion: Why can't I see the Approve button?
chatbotAnswer: The Approve button is only visible to users assigned the approver role for that request type. Check your role assignments with your administrator.

chatbotQuestion: How do I bulk approve multiple requests?
chatbotAnswer: Select the requests in the Mass Approval list and choose Approve. Only requests within your DoA limit can be approved in bulk.

chatbotQuestion: Where can I find my approval history?
chatbotAnswer: Open the Approval History tab in the DoA app. You can filter by date, status, and request type.
